name: pre_market_auction_edge_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: NSE pre-market auction (09:00-09:08) sets indicative prices that often differ from the continuous session opening price at 09:15. When the auction equilibrium price (AEP) is > 0.2% above/below the previous close AND the first 5 bars of continuous trading confirm the direction, a strong intraday move follows. The edge is in using the AEP as a leading indicator before most traders are watching. Persists because pre-market auction participation is low and dominated by institutional limit orders.
stock_filter: top 20 by avg daily turnover, stocks with > 500 pre-market orders on average

indicators.name: aep_vs_open
indicators.purpose: is AEP higher or lower than actual open

long.confirmation: enter at 09:20 after first 5 bars confirm

exit.signal_exit: close crosses VWAP against the trade direction

filters.trend_filter: AEP direction must align with first-5-bar direction
other_filters: aep_gap_pct must be > 0.2% to be meaningful

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — pre-market auction data is underutilized by most market participants

weaknesses: Pre-market auction data availability via Zerodha API is limited — may need alternative data source
AEP can differ significantly from continuous open if auction participation is low
Opening minutes have highest slippage — 4+ bps typical
prior_art: Pre-market auction analysis — NSE-specific, less studied in academic literature
notes: Requires access to pre-market auction data. Check if Zerodha Kite API provides AEP data.
